app.name: zvid
app.label: Zvid
app.description: Renders videos and images from JSON or reusable templates with Zvid.

modules.name: createRender
modules.label: Create a render
modules.description: Queues a video or image render from project JSON or a reusable template.

modules.name: createBulkRender
modules.label: Bulk create renders (advanced)
modules.description: Queues multiple video or image renders from one project or template and per-item variables.

modules.name: validateRender
modules.label: Validate a render payload
modules.description: Validates project JSON or a template against the account plan without rendering or spending credits.

modules.name: getRender
modules.label: Get a render
modules.description: Returns a render's status, progress, output URL, and failure details by job ID.

modules.name: getBulkRender
modules.label: Get a bulk render
modules.description: Returns batch progress and every render job for a bulk render.

modules.name: searchRenders
modules.label: Search renders
modules.description: Returns renders from the account, optionally filtered by media type.

modules.name: watchRenderEvents
modules.label: Watch render events
modules.description: Triggers when a render completes or fails.

modules.name: listTemplates
modules.label: List templates
modules.description: Returns reusable templates from the account.

modules.name: getTemplate
modules.label: Get a template
modules.description: Returns a template, including its project JSON and variables, by template ID.

modules.name: createTemplate
modules.label: Create a template
modules.description: Creates and validates a reusable video or image template from project JSON.

modules.name: updateTemplate
modules.label: Update a template
modules.description: Updates the name, description, or validated project JSON of an active template.

modules.name: archiveTemplate
modules.label: Archive a template
modules.description: Archives an active template so it can no longer be rendered or updated.

modules.name: duplicateTemplate
modules.label: Duplicate a template
modules.description: Creates an active editable copy of an owned template.

modules.name: previewTemplate
modules.label: Preview a template
modules.description: Resolves variables and validates a template without rendering or spending credits.

modules.name: renderFromTemplate
modules.label: Render from a template
modules.description: Queues a video or image render from a template and variable values.

modules.name: planCreativeVideo
modules.label: Plan a creative video
modules.description: Creates a plan-aware storyboard and creative direction before project JSON is authored.

modules.name: getProjectSchema
modules.label: Get the project schema
modules.description: Returns the plan-aware JSON Schema, validation notes, and authoring guidance.

modules.name: listSupportedElements
modules.label: List supported elements
modules.description: Returns supported project element types and professional authoring guidance.

modules.name: getElementDocumentation
modules.label: Get element documentation
modules.description: Returns fields, constraints, guidance, and an example for one project element type.

modules.name: getExampleProject
modules.label: Get an example project
modules.description: Returns a validated example project or the available built-in examples.

modules.name: repairProject
modules.label: Repair project JSON
modules.description: Repairs mechanical project JSON issues and returns remaining errors and layout warnings.

modules.name: searchCreativeAssets
modules.label: Search creative assets
modules.description: Returns matching examples, design templates, canvas presets, or shapes from Zvid's creative library.

modules.name: getCreativeAsset
modules.label: Get a creative asset
modules.description: Returns metadata for a creative-library asset by type and slug.

modules.name: getCreativeAssetContent
modules.label: Get creative asset content
modules.description: Returns the complete JSON content for a creative-library asset.

modules.name: searchStockMedia
modules.label: Search stock media
modules.description: Returns matching images, videos, GIFs, or audio from Zvid's stock library.

modules.name: getStockLibraryAvailability
modules.label: Get stock library availability
modules.description: Returns which media types are currently available in Zvid's stock library.

modules.name: getCreditBalance
modules.label: Get the credit balance
modules.description: Returns the account's total, subscription, and add-on credit balances.

modules.name: makeAnApiCall
modules.label: Make an API Call
modules.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized API call.
